svg.aria-label: Four sentences of one swap set pass the frozen text encoder. The two same-meaning vectors are summed, the two swapped ones are summed, and their difference w is what a sum of word slots cannot make. Cat and dog give 0.33 for order and 0.61 for binding, against 0.08 and 0.11 with random weights.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Average both word orders, and keep only what survives
a cat to the left of a dog
a dog to the right of a cat
a dog to the left of a cat
a cat to the right of a dog
0 for a pure sum of word slots, 1 when the whole swap survives
The binding set swaps colours the same way:
"a red cat and a blue dog" and "a blue dog and a red cat"
against "a blue cat and a red dog" and "a red dog and a blue cat".
Control: the same encoder with random weights
Text only: no image is read, so this says nothing about NoisyCLIP's image side. Values from word-check.json.
